Fixture porabuild accent vs ported HeroUI primary is a named token-source deviation, not a geometry failure.

Not verified: native is not HEAD-bound and motion/interaction were not driven.

setup: Render vertical tabs beside a constrained panel with long labels.
assertions: Pinned HeroUI wraps constrained vertical labels inside the fixed 32px tab box; the stylesheet ships no truncate, nowrap or overflow utility, so wrapped lines paint past the pill instead of growing the tab. Those overflow lines stay pointer-inert in the port.
Vertical overflow chevrons retain their position and 80%-of-viewport scroll step.

source.notes: Implementation regression is covered; the pinned fixed 32px tab box is matched. Overflow wrap lines paint past the pill and stay pointer-inert in the port.

setup: Render a SelectClearButton with custom content and exercise hover, press and hide/show.
assertions: The pressed scale(0.93) covers the whole control: the visual, glyph and expanded 24px pointer target shrink about the shared center (24 * 0.93 = 22.32px) and restore on release, as CSS transforms rescale hit testing without touching layout (pinned select.css .select__clear-button).

Custom child subtree scaling is a platform limit: gpui-pre 0.3.3 exposes paint transforms only on Svg (src/elements/svg.rs Svg::with_transformation, Transformation), and no Styled or div transform exists, so a composed child subtree cannot scale with the press.

source.notes: Converted from measured-gap: the pressed-target half is implemented and covered by clear_pressed_target_scales_about_the_slot_center in select_clear_deep.rs; the remaining custom-child half is a pinned-GPUI platform limit (transforms exist only on Svg elements). Re-recorded as platform-limited after the 2026-09-14 implementation-wave fingerprint change; custom-child subtree scaling is still gpui-pre 0.3.3 Svg-only.
